readme: Model catalog for the eval model bake-off. Prices are list prices gathered on the 'asof' date from the sources below and go stale — re-check before quoting a number. 'id' strings were taken from vendor pricing pages, NOT verified against a live API: run `tsx eval/bench/main.ts --verify-models` before the first --run and fix anything it reports. Add a model by appending an entry — no code change needed.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.note: The arm you asked for. Thinking disabled so this is a like-for-like classification call; see sonnet-5-thinking for the other half of that trade.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5 (adaptive thinking)
models.note: Same model, thinking on. Thinking tokens bill as output, so the estimate scales output 6x (a guess — a measured --run replaces it). This arm exists to price the trade, not because a labelling task obviously needs reasoning.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.note: Cheapest Anthropic tier — same key, same SDK, same invoice as the Sonnet arm. 200K context is far above what this task needs (p90 is ~5K).

models.label: OpenAI GPT-5.4
models.note: What eval-grader.pipe / eval-judge.pipe run today (profile openai-5-4). This is the baseline every other arm is measured against.

models.label: OpenAI GPT-5.4 Mini
models.note: Same family as the incumbent, ~3x cheaper. Lowest-friction downgrade: the OpenAI key is already in .env.

models.label: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna
models.note: Newer cheap tier, ~4x below 5.4 Mini. Verify the id — 'Luna' is a marketing name and the API slug may differ.

models.label: Groq GPT-OSS 120B
models.note: Open-weight model on Groq's LPUs — the cheap/fast end. Batch and prompt caching each cut 50% and stack.

models.label: Groq GPT-OSS 20B
models.note: Floor of the price range. Include it to find where accuracy actually breaks, not because it is expected to win.

models.label: xAI Grok 4.1 Fast
models.note: xAI's volume tier. Cheapest output price of any hosted frontier-family model here.

models.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.note: Peak-hours price shown (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri); off-peak is half. The 01:00 grading cron lands in peak — the off-peak window is a free 50% if you move it.

models.label: OpenRouter (template — edit id before use)
models.note: One key, every model above. Copy this entry, set 'id' to an OpenRouter slug and 'enabled': true to bake off a provider you have no direct account with.
